title: 公司数据整合与报表生成流程

name: diagram-title
text: 公司数据整合与报表生成流程

name: internal-body
text:
管理报表、流程图、制度
业务说明

name: transactions-body
text:
银行流水、转账记录
发票与合同

name: people-body
text:
员工、部门、岗位
工资单

name: updates-body
text:
增量更新，重查受影响项目
保留已发布版本

name: intake-body
text:
授权读取、上传或系统连接
保留原件、来源、版本及访问权限

name: extract-body
text:
OCR、表格与文档解析
提取主体、金额、日期及业务关系

name: normalize-body
text:
去重、统一格式、区分币种
关联同一员工、客户、供应商和账户

name: facts-body
text:
谁属于谁，谁向谁付款
识别对应的业务与事件
每条事实关联原始证据与可信度

name: links-body
text:
合同、发票、付款与银行流水
员工、工资批次、工资单与付款
按业务关系关联原始证据

name: settings-body
text:
主体范围、报表期间、币种
会计政策、科目表、期初余额

name: org-body
text:
法人关系、部门与岗位、汇报关系
业务流程、职责与审批关系

name: ledger-body
text:
科目分类、业务期间、应收应付
工资分录、总账与明细账

name: checks-body
text:
资料是否完整？金额是否一致？
是否存在关系冲突或重复记录？

name: publish-body
text:
区分原始事实、AI 推断和人工确认
保留审批记录与证据链

name: review-body
text:
补资料、修正识别、确认归属
由财务或业务负责人审核

name: structure-body
text:
组织架构图、法人关系图
业务流程图、职责与审批图

name: reports-body
text:
利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表
逐层追溯到明细与原始凭证

name: operations-body
text:
应收应付账龄、部门成本
工资报表、付款清单、异常清单
概念流程。自动处理依赖授权访问、证据质量和必要的人工确认，不能保证在证据缺失时生成完整且正确的报表。

name: internal-body
text:
Reports, policies and
process maps
Business descriptions

name: transactions-body
text:
Bank statements and transfers,
invoices and contracts

name: updates-body
text:
Refresh affected records
and retain published versions

name: intake-body
text:
Authorized access, uploads or connectors
Keep originals, sources, versions
and access permissions

name: extract-body
text:
OCR, table and document parsing
Extract entities, amounts, dates
and business relationships

name: normalize-body
text:
Deduplicate, standardize and retain currencies
Link records for the same employees,
customers, suppliers and accounts

name: facts-body
text:
Who belongs to whom, who pays whom,
and which business activity is involved
Link each fact to evidence and confidence

name: links-body
text:
Link contracts, invoices, payments
and bank records
Link staff, payroll batches and payslips

name: settings-body
text:
Entities, period and currencies
Policies and chart of accounts
Opening balances

name: org-body
text:
Legal entities, departments, roles
and reporting lines
Processes, responsibilities and approvals

name: ledger-body
text:
Classify accounts and accounting periods
Build receivables, payables, payroll
and general and subsidiary ledgers

name: checks-body
text:
Is the evidence complete? Do amounts agree?
Check conflicting relationships
and duplicate records

name: publish-body
text:
Distinguish source facts, AI inferences
and human confirmations
Retain approvals and the evidence trail

name: review-body
text:
Request evidence, correct extraction
and confirm ownership
Finance or business owners review

name: structure-body
text:
Organisation and legal entity charts
Business process maps
Responsibilities and approval paths

name: reports-body
text:
Profit and loss, balance sheet,
and cash flow
Trace to records and original evidence

name: operations-body
text:
Receivables and payables ageing
Department costs, payroll reports
Payment lists and exception queues
Conceptual workflow. Automation depends on authorized access, evidence quality and required human approval. Missing evidence can prevent complete and correct reporting.
